scope: Functional McKernel OS/apps and Rust/assembly migration only; no security testing.
source_meaning: Rust result-5 is Failure::Pair, not Linux errno-5.
P12_LONG_FAILURE is emitted only after long_dispatch/Rust returns, so retained wire proves first-round failure returned; it does not describe an unresolved callback that has not returned.

Last pair callback phase callback-launch, followed by Failure::Pair, means launch returned nonzero or uncertain-safe before load; captured summary ownership0 keeps main on its unchanged unsafe hold path.
ABORT precedes actual raw snapshot export; trace END present, so retained failure export completed.
Underlying app/cleanup/syscall cause remains unknown; kernel tail literals alone do not establish causality.
